meta.title: 4HOPE — Tools for the LATAM TFT community
meta.description: 4HOPE builds tools that make playing, organizing and competing in Teamfight Tactics easier. Starting with TFT Competition Bracket. Made in LATAM, for LATAM.

hero.sub: Good vibes, camaraderie, a little luck — that's 4Hope. TFT and League, always together.

whatIs.title: Built by gamers. Powered by ideas.
whatIs.lead: 4HOPE is a gaming and technology company founded by entrepreneurs from LATAM. We create tools, games, and data-driven experiences that bring players and communities closer together.

points.title: Born in LATAM
points.body: Founded by LATAM entrepreneurs, creating gaming experiences for players everywhere.

points.title: Games & Technology
points.body: Building gaming tools, developing games, and exploring new ways to play.

points.title: Data & Insights
points.body: Turning gaming data into useful insights, statistics, and interactive reports.

tools.title: Our first tool
tools.lead: TFT Competition Bracket is the first tool 4HOPE has built: set up a tournament in minutes and share it with your community. More are on the way.

bracket.desc: Build single-elimination brackets for players or teams. Advance winners in one click and share the link with your community.

teams.title: Competitive team
teams.body: We're putting together the 4HOPE competitive team. Follow it on Discord to hear first about tryouts, the roster and matches.

community.title: Join the community
community.body: Run tournaments, find your squad, share your brackets and tell us what to build next.

items.a: A gaming and technology company founded by entrepreneurs from LATAM. We create tools, games and data-driven experiences for TFT and League players and their communities. Our first tool is TFT Competition Bracket.
Nothing. TFT Competition Bracket is free, and so is your 4HOPE account.

items.q: Is 4HOPE an official Riot Games product?
items.a: No. 4HOPE is an independent company and isn't endorsed by Riot Games. Teamfight Tactics and League of Legends are trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.
We're working on new tools, games and data experiences for TFT and League, like stats and interactive reports. Follow the Discord to hear about them first.
Yes. Message us on Discord or by email and tell us what you'd like to see: a tool, a game or a stat you're missing.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.metaDescription: How 4HOPE handles your data on 4hope.app: cookie-free analytics and no personal data.

sections.p: 4hope.app doesn't use cookies or browser storage to track you.
We count visits in aggregate with a cookie-free analytics tool. We don't collect personal data or build profiles, and we don't share data with advertisers.
Each tool (for example, bracket.4hope.app) may have its own policy. Check it inside the tool.
If you have privacy questions, email us at our contact address.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.metaDescription: The rules for using 4hope.app and your 4HOPE account: what we offer, what we expect from you, and how we handle your content.

sections.p: By using 4hope.app or creating a 4HOPE account you agree to these terms and our Privacy Policy. If you don't agree, don't use the service.
4HOPE is a community project offering free tools for Teamfight Tactics players in LATAM. Some tools live on their own subdomains (for example, bracket.4hope.app) and may have additional rules.

You sign in with your Google account. You must be at least 13, or the minimum age required by law in your country. You're responsible for what happens with your account. Your player name is unique and can't be changed; your display name and photo can.

You can link your Riot account by signing in to Riot, which confirms it's yours. Only link accounts you own. We show your Riot ID, server and TFT rank on your profile, and you can unlink the account at any time.

Don't impersonate others, don't use offensive, discriminatory or sexual names or images, don't harass anyone, and don't try to interfere with the service or abuse it with automation. We may edit or remove content and suspend accounts that break these rules.
Your display name and photo remain yours. You give us permission to show them within 4HOPE while you have an account. Only upload images you have the right to use.

4HOPE isn't endorsed by Riot Games and doesn't reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games, Teamfight Tactics and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.
4HOPE is free and provided as is. It may change, be interrupted or shut down. Match and rank data come from the Riot API and may be delayed or wrong.
To the extent the law allows, 4HOPE and its team aren't liable for indirect damages or losses arising from using the service or being unable to use it.
You can ask us to delete your account and your data at any time by writing to our contact email.
We may update these terms. The date above shows the current version. If a change is significant, we'll ask you to accept the terms again.
If you have questions about these terms, write to our contact email.
